name: gtm-guard
description: A best-effort check that makes Claude stop and ask before calls that look like sending email, launching a sequence, spending enrichment credits, changing CRM records or deleting data through your sales tools (MCP servers or direct API calls), even if you allowed those tools before. It matches known tool names and API hosts, so it is a safety net, not a guarantee. Keeps a log of every such call.

mode.title: What to do with a risky call
mode.description: ask = Claude asks you every time (default). block-sends = sends, launches and deletes are refused outright; other writes and credit spends still ask.

extra_servers.title: Extra MCP server names to guard
extra_servers.description: Comma-separated. Add the name you gave a sales tool's MCP server if it is not in the built-in list (for example: lm, outreach-prod).

log_calls.title: Keep a local log of guarded calls
log_calls.description: One line per call (tool, category, decision, input field names and list sizes; for a generic API tool the method and a path of route words only). No bodies, field values or path values.
